youtube.title: 1 Jellyfish Reverses Aging Forever #shorts

instagram.caption:
This jellyfish reverses aging & lives forever 🪼

Turritopsis dohrnii can rewind from old age back to infancy and restart its life. When stressed, it transforms cells backward through time—hitting a biological reset button. It theoretically never dies.

Would you reverse your aging once, or stay where you are?
